decisive_items: Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass
response.rationale: R4 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including the presence of an intra-articular lesion, internal specks on T2-weighted images, and peripheral rim enhancement on Gadolinium-enhanced MRI. R1 is the runner-up because it also has significant support from the vignette, but lacks the specific detail of internal specks.
